source.basis: Operator spec page; structured facts only, no operator prose reproduced.

reading.body:
CyrusOne Norwalk (NYM5) publishes 4 MW of IT capacity and 168,000 square feet of technical space, with a suitability score of 49 out of 100 because no expansion is announced.

The 4 MW figure is the site's entire disclosed power envelope. The 168,000 square feet of technical space is a building fact, but without a power density or rack count, the data does not say how much of that space can be used for high-power AI hardware. The missing announced expansion is the main gap in the suitability score, which is based only on published IT capacity and operator type.

The SSAE 16 Type II certification is the one operational detail that matters for regulated workloads requiring audited physical and logical access controls. The data does not cover grid connection, power purchase agreements, or latency, so it cannot support a stronger conclusion about the site's role in AI scaling.

suitability.basis: weighted mean of the published inputs named here, scaled to 100; formula on the methodology page
